headline: CF Industries Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: CF Industries (NYSE:CF) reported first-half 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $2.2 billion and second-quarter adjusted EBITDA of $1.2 billion, as tight global nitrogen supply-demand conditions and strong operating performance supported results. Net earnings attributable to common stockholders totaled $1.3 bi
